summary: Iteration 3 (rebrand + PDF selection bridge + Lessons + Drafts + Teacher upload). Backend: 23/23 passing (100%) with 8 new tests added — TestRebrand (service='gcsharp'), TestLessons (list>=4, GET increments views by 1, ?exam_level=Concours filter, student POST 403, teacher POST 200), TestAISolution (returns title/steps>=2 with heading+body/narration), TestDrafts (POST→GET→DELETE→GET round-trip), plus all iteration_2 regression tests (auth, onboarding, subjects, past-papers, questions/answer, analytics, library, teacher/overview, ai/chat, pmm2.pdf & pmm3.pdf) still green. Frontend on 390x844 mobile viewport: rebrand verified (Welcome hero shows 'GCSHARP' + 'Global Classroom Sharpening Potentials'; Home header shows 'GCSHARP'; no 'GCSMART' text left on Welcome). Bottom nav shows exactly 5 tabs: Home / Lessons / AI / Library / Profile. Lessons tab (testID='lessons-screen') renders 5 lesson cards with thumbnail + play overlay + duration tag ('05:12', '08:44', etc.) + GCE A/Pure Mathematics pills; tapping a card navigates to /lesson/{id} where testID='lesson-detail' mounts and a <video> element renders (expo-video/VideoView works on web preview). Profile → My Drafts (testID='row-drafts') opens /drafts (testID='drafts-screen') showing a saved 'Q3 draft' with Resume + trash-can delete. AI seed navigation works: /(tabs)/ai?seed=Solve+x%2B2%3D5 auto-triggers chat and returns a proper step-by-step Claude reply. PDF viewer: /pdf?url=/api/pdfs/pmm2.pdf mounts testID='pdf-viewer' and shows 'Highlight any question to use GC AI' hint. Teacher flow: teacher@gcsmart.cm login redirects to /teacher (dashboard). Teacher-upload screen (/teacher-upload) mounts testID='teacher-upload-screen' with all 6 form fields (in-title, in-desc, in-subject, in-url, in-duration, submit-lesson). teacher-upload-btn correctly hidden on Lessons tab for student role. Two web-preview limitations (informational): (1) pdf-webview does NOT render on web because react-native-webview has no web support — modal selection bridge (ask/video/draft sheets) cannot be exercised via Playwright postMessage since the WebView itself is absent; must verify on Expo Go / native. (2) Teachers on login land on /teacher (not /(tabs)/lessons), so the teacher-upload-btn on Lessons tab header is only reachable if a teacher manually navigates to /lessons — deep-link /teacher-upload works fine, but there is no obvious in-app entry point for teachers to reach it from their /teacher dashboard.

integration_issues.issue: Teachers land on /teacher (dashboard) after login and the bottom-tab Lessons screen is not part of the teacher navigation. As a result, 'teacher-upload-btn' in the Lessons header is unreachable for teachers via normal UI; /teacher-upload only reachable via deep link. Add an 'Upload lesson' CTA on the /teacher dashboard.

issues: pdf-webview (react-native-webview) does not render on Expo web preview — ask-sheet/video-sheet/save-sheet flows triggered by pdf.js postMessage cannot be exercised in Playwright; must validate on Expo Go / native.
expo-speech playback (speak-btn) also cannot be audibly verified on web; only the UI toggle is testable.

action_items: Consider adding an 'Upload lesson' CTA on /teacher dashboard so teachers can reach /teacher-upload without deep-link; currently the teacher-upload-btn on Lessons tab is only surfaced to student-facing tab layout which teachers do not enter.

Deprecation warnings 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking but should be migrated for RN 0.75+ compliance.

Manual verification still required on Expo Go / native for: pdf.js WebView loading pmm2.pdf/pmm3.pdf, ask-sheet/video-sheet/save-sheet triggered by highlight selection, expo-speech narration playback, expo-video full playback controls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/lessons/{lesson_id} correctly increments views atomically via $inc and returns updated count. Good.
server.py: /api/ai/solution safely strips ```json fences and falls back to {title, steps:[{heading,body:reply}], narration:reply} on JSON parse failure — resilient.
server.py: /api/drafts DELETE returns {deleted: count} without 404 when the id is missing/owned by another user; acceptable but returning 404 would be more RESTful.
'shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings persist app-wide — non-blocking.
